hommock.definition:
n. A small eminence of a conical form, of land or of ice; a
   knoll; a hillock. See Hummock.
hommock.translation: n. [地](冰原上的)冰丘,堆积冰

hommos.definition: n a thick spread made from mashed chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and garlic; used especially as a dip for pita; originated in the Middle East
hommos.translation: n. 鹰嘴豆泥, 鹰嘴豆沙
